approach: Agents of a study job get a tree without the other systems' studies; Athena's gate does not. Add `Snapshot::create_hiding(..., hidden: &[String])` in athena-git (existing `create` and public `materialize` keep their signatures and mean "full tree"). Hidden directories are dropped when the snapshot is materialized, so they are absent from both sides of the snapshot's diff; `change_list()` also drops stray paths under them and `hidden_writes()` reports those drops. `Athena::hidden_study_dirs(ctx)` in run/pin.rs reads the repository URL of the job's recorded pin and returns every `studies/<d>` at the base whose pin.json URL (normalised) differs or is unreadable; a change job has no pin and hides nothing. The producer snapshot, the reader and the verifier AGENT snapshot use it. The checks, demonstration reverts and baseline run in the unhidden snapshots. In `verification_stage` the hiding snapshot is swapped in right after `Checked` is destructured (before `candidate_view`, `inputs` and the disk check), and a "not a check" entry in `inputs.checks` tells the verifier which directories are hidden and that tests reading them fail in its view while the recorded checks ran on the full tree. Last, add the hermes-agent table to athena.toml. Step 1 stops the producer if the base lacks the systems schema or a request-text selector (I grepped crates/athena-data/src/config.rs for `systems`: no match in the copy I read).

decisions.choice: Keep the gate on the full tree and hide only from the agents. Checks (mod.rs:1936-1937 via `verifier_snapshot`), demonstration reverts (checks.rs:663) and baseline checks (checks.rs:955) call the unhidden functions. `verification_stage` rebuilds the verifier snapshot with `verifier_snapshot_hiding` at the same `verify_dir` straight after destructuring `Checked` (verification.rs:40-50), before `candidate_view` (:58) and `inputs` (:64) are built, replacing `vsnap`, `prepared` and `tool_config_from_base`; the reruns at :313 and :341 use the hiding form too.
decisions.reason: Answers finding 5 (minor): the swap moves from before the disk check (:157) to before :58, so `tool_config_from_base` (:79) and the diff view (:61) come from the snapshot the verifier actually works in. The checks already ran in mod.rs:1936-2144 on the full tree, and demonstrations use their own dir (checks.rs:663), so nothing needs the swap to come later. The study check `cargo test --locked` (athena.toml:122-125) must see studies/firstmate-work-handling (drain.rs:5017 `include_str!`, tests/drain.rs:6948, site_page.rs:11, cap-study rules.rs:1435), so it must run on the full tree. The rebuild reuses `verify_dir`, removes the old dir (`remove_tree`, verification.rs:454) and re-mounts `ctx.pin_dir`.

rejected.why: Touches athena-cli tests, cap-study rules tests and the xtask site generator (site.rs:17); the site is out of scope.

rejected.option: Hide in the checks snapshot too
rejected.why: Every Hermes job would fail its own `cargo test` check on unchanged repository tests.

rejected.option: Do the swap just before the disk check (:157)
rejected.why: The brief's inputs would already carry the tool configuration and diff from the old snapshot (finding 5).

decisions.choice: Leave `Snapshot::create` and public `materialize` as they are; add `create_hiding` and `materialize_hiding`. Only the reader, the producer snapshot and the verifier-agent snapshot call the hiding form.
decisions.reason: run/mod.rs, run/checks.rs, run/planning.rs and steward.rs need no edit; planning and the steward read the full tree on purpose and a study is never planned (run_pin_tests.rs:325). This also keeps steward.rs out of the change set (it is in the reading's list but needs no edit).

rejected.option: Make the hidden list a required parameter of `create`
rejected.why: Forces edits in mod.rs, checks.rs, planning.rs and steward.rs, all passing an empty list.

decisions.choice: Choose the directories to hide by the URL of the job's recorded pin (`ctx.job.job.pin`): keep `studies/<d>` whose pin.json `repository_url` equals the pin's `url` after stripping a trailing `/` and `.git`; hide every other directory, including one whose pin.json is missing or not valid JSON. `study_pin`'s exact-match rule stays.
decisions.reason: Directory name is not the system id (`firstmate-work-handling` vs `firstmate`), and the URL is the join key study_pin uses. A normalised comparison cannot hide a system's own study over a `.git` mismatch. Failing closed on an unreadable pin follows BRIEF S1. It does not depend on how the schema selects a system.

rejected.option: Match the directory name to the system id
rejected.why: firstmate's own study would be hidden from its own job.
Needs a second mapping from system id to config.

decisions.choice: The reader hides other studies only when the shared system selector (the one `pin_repo` uses, extracted into `study_system_url(config, request) -> Option<String>` in pin.rs only if private) returns exactly one URL. Step 1 reads the base's selector first and stops if there is none or it needs something the reader lacks.
decisions.reason: The reader's notion of 'system b' is exactly what the job later pins; no invented whole-word matcher. Trade-off stated: the reader runs before the capability is known (reading.rs:551), so a change request that names a configured system id gets a reader view without the other studies; its producer and verifier still see all studies because they follow the pin.

rejected.option: Hide all studies from every reader
rejected.why: A change request about studies/firstmate-work-handling needs them.
Criterion 2 requires the reader's snapshot to omit the other studies.

decisions.choice: `change_list()` drops entries at or under a hidden directory; `Snapshot::hidden_writes()` returns them; the producer loop (producer.rs after :413) prints one `hidden` line naming them. Nothing new goes in the job record.
decisions.reason: Hidden directories are absent from both the snapshot's base and work tree, so the diff never shows them as 'D'. `build_candidate` (candidate.rs:34) applies only the change entries to the full base tree, so hidden directories keep their base blobs and land byte-identical. A stray write is not landed and the owner sees the attempt.

rejected.option: Refuse a job that writes under a hidden directory
rejected.why: A new study whose name collides would stop an otherwise good run.

decisions.choice: Answers finding 2 (major): tell the verifier, in code, what it cannot run. When the hidden list is non-empty, `verification_stage` pushes one entry onto `inputs.checks`: name `hidden-study-directories`, command `not a check`, passed true, detail naming each hidden directory and saying that tests which read them (athena-cli drain tests, xtask site_page, `cargo test -p athena-cap-study` rules tests) fail or do not compile in the verifier's own view, that the recorded checks ran on the full tree and decide, and that such failures are not evidence against the candidate. Same pattern as `producer-report-gaps` (verification.rs:100-112). Code only: no always-loaded prompt text changes, so budgets do not move.
decisions.reason: The verifier's grant includes cargo test, clippy and check (athena.toml:108), and its verdict feeds `judge` (verification.rs:396-411). In a Hermes job the hidden view makes `cargo test`/`clippy --all-targets` fail on drain.rs:5017 (compile), tests/drain.rs:6948, site_page.rs:11 and rules.rs:1435 (`expect("a study file")`). Without this entry the verifier could reject good work. The entry fails nothing, as the recorded checks decide.

rejected.option: Only document the limit for the producer

risks.risk: The base lacks the systems schema, so criterion 1 and the athena.toml entry cannot hold.
risks.mitigation: Step 1 stops the producer if the schema or the request-text selector is absent and lands nothing; the plan does not invent either.

risks.risk: The verifier agent works in the hidden view and may run `cargo test`/`clippy --all-targets` there (its grant, athena.toml:108); the tests that read studies/firstmate-work-handling (drain.rs:5017 compile error, tests/drain.rs:6948, site_page.rs:11, cap-study rules.rs:1435) then fail, and a wrong rejection could follow via `judge` (verification.rs:396-411) (finding 2).
risks.mitigation: A 'not a check', passed `hidden-study-directories` entry in `inputs.checks` names the hidden directories and says such failures are artefacts of its view while the recorded checks ran on the full tree. The criterion-3 test asserts the entry is present for a study job and absent for a change job. The residual risk is a verifier that ignores the entry; it is put to the user.

risks.risk: `cargo test -p athena-cap-study` fails (panics at rules.rs:1435 `expect("a study file")`) inside a study agent's hidden snapshot for a Hermes job, and a producer may run it to check its own study (finding 3).
risks.mitigation: The entry names this crate; the gate and CI run it on the full tree and decide; listed in dependents and the open question. The producer's fmt and `cargo build` still work.

risks.risk: The rebuilt verifier snapshot differs from the one the checks ran in, so the verifier could judge a different tree.
risks.mitigation: Both come from the same base and candidate commits; only hidden directories differ, and the change list never includes them. The rebuild's tree becomes `prepared`, which the snapshot-unchanged check and both reruns compare against. The criterion-3 test lands a job through this path.

risks.risk: A study directory with no readable pin.json is hidden from every study job, including its own system's.
risks.mitigation: Study rules require a pin.json per study. A test commits a study without a pin.json and asserts it is hidden, so the fail-closed rule is fixed.

risks.risk: The reader hides other studies for a change request that names a study system.
risks.mitigation: The match is the same selector the pin uses and applies only when exactly one system is selected. Test 2(d) fixes the behaviour; the open question asks the user to accept it.

risks.risk: A planner or critic of a study job would see all studies.
risks.mitigation: A study is never planned (run_pin_tests.rs:325 'a study is not planned even with job planning enabled'), so no such snapshot exists today.

risks.risk: Other study jobs' records stay readable to the verifier through the evidence snapshot (crates/athena-core/src/snapshot.rs:1-7; verification.rs:179-212) (finding 6).
risks.mitigation: Out of scope by the request (studies/<id>/ in agent snapshots). Stated in docs/design/study-capability-m1.md and the CHANGELOG entry as a known remaining channel for a follow-up job.

risks.risk: scope_guard.rs, outside the reading's list, is edited (finding 1).
risks.mitigation: Edited only if an empty hermes-agent table fails to parse after the helper strips its keys, decided in step 1; the edit is the same few filter lines as the two listed helpers, and the final report names it.

demonstrations.method: Test `hermes_agent_pins_its_tag_and_firstmate_keeps_its_pin_json_sha` in run_pin_tests.rs. It parses `include_str!("../../../athena.toml")` with `athena_data::Config::parse` and asserts the hermes-agent system holds repo_url https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent.git and repo_ref v2026.9.24. It builds a repository from that unstripped text (only `[job_plan]` and `cutover_job` removed, as `config()` does at :84-97), commits `studies/firstmate-work-handling/pin.json` with firstmate's URL and a 40-hex SHA literal in the test (via `add_studies`, :615; the test never reads the real studies/ file), and runs two study jobs through `Athena::ask` and `Athena::go`: one request selects hermes-agent, one firstmate. `Athena::go` calls `pin_repo` (pin.rs:22) before dispatch.
demonstrations.observes: The parse succeeds. For the hermes job `pinner.requests()` is exactly [("https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent.git", "v2026.9.24")]. For firstmate it is [("https://github.com/kunchenguid/firstmate.git", <pin.json sha>)] and the job record's `pin.sha` equals that sha.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the athena.toml entry the parse assertion finds no hermes-agent system. If hermes were pinned at `main`, `requests()` differs. If firstmate's `study_pin` override were lost, its request would carry the config ref, not the pin.json sha.
demonstrations.seam: Production entry `Athena::go` -> `pin_repo` (run/pin.rs:22). Fake: `CountingPinner::new(FAKE_SHA).echoing_full_shas()` (fake.rs:23-44), injected as the `pinner` field in `athena_with` (run_pin_tests.rs:257); `add_studies` exists (:615). The unstripped-config helper is added in step 8.

demonstrations.method: (a) snapshot.rs unit tests (names contain `hidden_studies`): repository with studies/a, studies/b, README.md; `create_hiding` with ["studies/a"] for `None`, `Base`, `BaseAndCandidate`, `BaseThenTree`; control with `&[]` shows both. (b) run_pin_tests.rs `hidden_studies_study_job_agents_lack_other_studies`: studies a and b committed via `add_studies` with a pin.json URL each, two configured study systems, request selecting b, run through `Athena::ask` (read_once, reading.rs:551) and `Athena::go` (producer_snapshot producer.rs:125; verifier agent snapshot via the swap in verification_stage). A `Tweak` on `FakeAgentDriver` records for Reader, Producer and Verifier whether `spec.workdir.join("studies/a")` and `studies/b` exist. (c) Answers finding 4 (minor): `hidden_studies_plain_change_job_sees_all` runs a change job through `Athena::ask` and `Athena::go` using a second fake capability `PlainChange` (id "change", no pin, check `true`) passed through the new `capability` parameter of `athena_with`, with a request that names no configured system id and no study path; it records the same three roles. (d) `hidden_studies_change_request_naming_a_system`: same fake, request names a configured system.
demonstrations.observes: Study job naming b: Reader, Producer and Verifier each hold studies/b and none holds studies/a. Plain change job (c): Reader, Producer and Verifier all hold both studies/a and studies/b, read from the real working directories, not from the selector's return value. (d): the Reader lacks the other studies (stated trade-off), Producer and Verifier hold both. Snapshot-level: hidden shows studies/b only for all four repo modes; control shows both. Reader unit tests for request forms (one system, none, several, id inside a path or prefix of another id) assert the reader's hide decision equals the shared selector's result, in addition to the end-to-end runs.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the hidden list in `materialize_hiding`, studies/a exists in every study agent directory and the 'lacks studies/a' assertions fail. If change jobs also hid studies, the (c) 'holds both' assertions fail. If the verifier swap were missing, the verifier would see studies/a.
demonstrations.seam: Production entry points `Athena::ask`, `Athena::go`, `Snapshot::create_hiding`. Fixture: `FakeAgentDriver` with the `Tweak` closure at run_pin_tests.rs:152, injected in `athena_with` (:154-259); both exist. The `capability` parameter of `athena_with` and `create_hiding` are added by steps 2 and 8.

demonstrations.method: (a) snapshot.rs unit tests (names contain `hidden_directory`): repository with studies/a, studies/b and a normal file; `Base` and `BaseAndCandidate` with hidden ["studies/a"]; edit studies/b, write studies/a/new.txt, then `change_list()`; a bad entry (empty, absolute, `..`) is refused. (b) run_pin_tests.rs `hidden_directory_lands_unchanged_and_the_gate_still_sees_it`: a fake-driver study job selecting b run through `Athena::go` to landing. The study fake capability gains a `check` field set to ["sh","-c","test -f studies/a/pin.json"], which runs for real in the gate's snapshot. The producer `Tweak` edits README.md and also writes studies/a/x.json. A recording UI keeps the lines. The test compares `git.show_file("HEAD", "studies/a/<file>")` with the bytes committed before the run, reads `git diff --name-status <base> HEAD`, and (finding 2) reads the stored `brief-verifier.md` (written at verification.rs:183) or the verifier driver's prompt, asserting it holds the `hidden-study-directories` entry naming studies/a, marked `not a check`, passed.
demonstrations.observes: The change list holds the studies/b edit and no entry under studies/a: no 'D', no 'A'. The job lands. Every studies/a file in HEAD equals its pre-run bytes and the landed diff holds only README.md. The UI shows the `hidden` line naming studies/a/x.json. The check passes (gate on the full tree) while the verifier agent's workdir lacks studies/a. The verifier brief carries the `hidden-study-directories` entry, and a plain change job's brief (from test 2c) carries none.
demonstrations.fails_without: If the hidden directory came from the work tree after the base commit, `change_list` would report its files as 'D' and landing would delete them. Without the `change_list` filter, studies/a/x.json would land. If the checks ran in the hidden snapshot, `test -f studies/a/pin.json` would fail and the job would be Rejected, not Landed. Without the verifier entry, the brief assertion fails.
demonstrations.seam: Entry points `Snapshot::change_list`, `Athena::build_candidate` (candidate.rs:26) via `Athena::go`. Fixture: `FakeAgentDriver` and `Tweak` (producer edits from `turn.edits`, as at run_pin_tests.rs:202). Checks run via `sh -c` as in run/tests.rs:100. The `check` field and the recording UI are added by step 8; the rest exists.

The refusal corpus (INPUT_FORMS, refusal_corpus.rs:90; cases() from :292) tests reading checks and has no case about file visibility; I cite no case ids and no result.

open_questions: Host: Does this job's base commit hold the systems schema, that is `[capabilities.study.systems.<id>]` with repo_url and repo_ref, and a way to select the system a request names? The copy I read does not (no `systems` in crates/athena-data/src/config.rs; `pin_repo` in pin.rs reads one `[capabilities.study]` section). If it is missing, step 1 stops the producer and reports; it builds neither.

User: Accept that a change request which names a configured study system id gets a reader view without the other studies (the reader runs at reading.rs:551 before the capability is known), while its producer and verifier see all studies? Criterion 2's 'a change job's snapshots hold both' holds end to end for a request naming no system and for the producer and verifier otherwise.

User: Accept that inside a study job's hidden snapshot, both the producer and the verifier agent (whose grant includes cargo test, clippy and check, athena.toml:108) fail on tests that read studies/firstmate-work-handling (drain.rs:5017, tests/drain.rs:6948, site_page.rs:11, cap-study rules.rs:1435), while Athena's gate and CI on the full tree decide the result and the verifier is told by a 'not a check' entry? The alternative is a separate job that moves those fixtures out of studies/, which touches the site generator and is out of scope here.
